title: Chapter 17 — The Map That Should Not Exist

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The Map That Should Not Exist
lines.note: Chapter title. Leave a clean beat before story begins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They met at dusk in the shaded courtyard of the inn, long after the heat had bled from the stone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek set the satchel on the table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For ten days he had not opened the journal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Nine days had become ten that morning. The refusal had felt precise. Deliberate. A clean edge drawn between himself and whatever had begun writing in his father's hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Now Ahm-MAH-roo's words were disappearing from clay.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: His father's name had waited in a drawer older than his birth.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And the journal had followed them through a drain where water climbed uphill.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Do not touch anything until we understand what changed.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: You were the one asking me to open it.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: That is not permission to become careless.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: You have an interesting relationship with consistency.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: I am consistent about other people being cautious.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-KHEH-doo rested one ankle on her opposite knee.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Open the book before it finds another way to complain.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The cover flexed beneath his fingers.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He pulled it out and placed it on the table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rain whispered against the courtyard canopy. Beyond the wall, someone laughed, the sound muffled by wet brick. The journal sat in the middle of the table as though it belonged there.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Most terrible ideas begin with those words.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon leaned closer without touching it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The thread along the spine no longer sat perfectly straight. It rose and settled almost imperceptibly, as though something beneath the cover had shifted.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: This one may become one again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek rested two fingers against the cover.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Not the warmth of a book carried beneath a cloak.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He slipped a thumb beneath the edge of the leather.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then, before he could lift it—

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Pages turned in a rapid dry flutter, though there was no wind beneath the canopy. Blank leaves flashed past. Old calculations. BAYL-ID-din's survey notes. A fragment about the western tomb. Lists of names Zeek had not yet studied.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The pages stopped near the middle.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Across two facing sheets, wet ink spread from the binding.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Lines extended outward in thin black threads.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her fingers hovered inches above the parchment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At first, the strokes formed the broad shape of OO-rook.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The temple district raised above the lower streets.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Old roads disappeared beneath newer ones. Abandoned settlements clustered beyond the walls like broken teeth in the earth.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ink bled downward from the familiar geography, creating shafts, chambers, stairs, and inverted towers beneath the city. Some structures hung below others like roots from an overturned tree. Others occupied spaces that could not exist together, overlapping without crossing.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: It is not a surface plan.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She pulled one of her own tablets closer and began sketching the outline beside the journal.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: If this were a city plan…

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her stylus hovered above the clay.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Perhaps whoever drew it was a poor surveyor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon turned the journal ninety degrees.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She looked at the drawing one last time.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: It isn't meant to be viewed from above.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The ink river turned downward in a wide spiral. At three points, channels split from it and entered separate levels beneath the city.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: You just called it a section.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: A section requires a scale. This has none.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She traced the outline of the east-side wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A line descended from the defaced spiral-drop they had copied that morning. It passed through two buried chambers before joining a circular structure beneath the tanners' row.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The boxes NEEN-soon had drawn on her map—CLAIMED, COST, LIMIT—corresponded to small black marks along the descending line.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: It has more than our passages.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Below each known shifted street, the map showed additional routes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Some paths ended in black circles. Others joined a large spiral that continued below the bottom edge of the page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg looked over from the courtyard entrance.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Does it show a way out?

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: It shows too many ways in,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon leaned nearer to the page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The light did not reflect from the parchment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sheet became faintly translucent. Dark fibers appeared inside the material, branching beneath the surface in irregular patterns. They were thicker near the binding and finer toward the edges.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She pointed to a pale ridge crossing the lower corner of the right-hand page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It forked once before ending beneath a cluster of newly drawn stairs.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon lowered herself until her eyes were level with the page.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: The tissue thickened along both sides.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Parchment damage splits fibers. This closed before the material was cured.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The musician in the alley played the same three notes again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon examined the dark points scattered beneath the ink.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Too sparse for goat. Too irregular for sheep.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She moved to the opposite sheet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Another pale mark lay near the outer edge. Not a cut this time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A small round depression surrounded by puckered tissue.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: The scar belonged to the body before the page belonged to the book.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek looked at his father's old handwriting between the spreading lines.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The carters near the well stopped arguing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The carter grimaced and moved his game pieces farther away.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg stepped from the entrance and approached the table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon looked at the seam where the pages met the binding.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: That means more than one is possible.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek touched the edge of the cover, careful not to contact the page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark beneath his linen throbbed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A slow pressure spread through his palm.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The largest spiral-drop symbol appeared at the lowest visible point of the map. The ink gathered gradually, filling the jagged outline until it became darker than anything else on the pages.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The symbol was not inside a chamber.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Seven narrow routes descended toward a central blank space. Six ended before reaching it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The seventh continued beyond the bottom edge of the parchment.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-KHEH-doo glanced toward the copied ledger hidden in NEEN-soon's robe.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Until someone used his name as a key,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A golden spark moved through the black symbol.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg's hand went to his axe.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-KHEH-doo's fingers closed around her knife hilt.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The spark traveled upward from the spiral, following one of the routes through the underground city.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The lantern flame bent toward the page.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek's palm pulsed in the same rhythm.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Tell me that was reflected light,

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The golden line reached the surface map and crossed west.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The route passed abandoned roads and dry channels. It ended at a rectangular chamber beneath a cluster of burial mounds.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The chamber where KOO-rahsh had died.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon rotated the journal toward herself.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The map did not end at the burial chamber.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It passed through a narrow black band and entered another structure below the known tomb—larger, older, and drawn with lines that appeared less like masonry than bone.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: We thought the chamber was the bottom.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The golden spark reached the lower structure.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A memory struck Zeek with such force that his hand slipped from the table.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A descending passage where the air had pressed against his ears.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KOO-rahsh's voice behind him, joking because silence had become worse.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A surface at the far end that reflected no lamplight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Something that had seemed to move when no one looked directly at it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The ink around the buried structure thickened.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: New handwriting appeared in the margin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The ink appeared one drop at a time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Darkness gathered beneath the surface of the page until a single line pushed upward.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: I preferred it when books stayed books.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Each one seemed to press through the page rather than settle upon it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek found himself holding his breath.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sentence completed itself one word at a time.

lines.speaker: Bel-iddin
lines.text: I WAS WRONG ABOUT THE DEPTH.
lines.note: Writing rises through the page in Bel-iddin's hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sound cracked through the courtyard.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one spoke for several breaths.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rain dripped steadily from the reed canopy into the basin beside the well.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Back to the place that killed KOO-rahsh?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek rested both hands on the closed journal.

lines.speaker: Zik
lines.text: We never reached the place that killed him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: NEEN-soon looked down at the leather cover.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: We stopped one level too soon.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-KHEH-doo's voice was barely above a whisper.
